+"""Locate the isolated bytecode cache directory for a source file."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+
+def isolated_bytecode_dir(file_path: Path) -> Path:
+    """Return the isolated cache directory for .pyc files of the given .py file path.
+
+    Mirrors :func:`_pytest.assertion.rewrite.get_cache_dir`, but uses a
+    ``.pytest_bytecode`` directory instead of ``__pycache__`` when
+    ``sys.pycache_prefix`` is not set.
+    """
+    if sys.pycache_prefix:
+        # given:
+        #   prefix = '/tmp/pycs'
+        #   path = '/home/user/proj/test_app.py'
+        # we want:
+        #   '/tmp/pycs/home/user/proj'
+        return Path(sys.pycache_prefix) / Path(*file_path.parts[1:-1])
+    else:
+        # isolated bytecode directory
+        return file_path.parent / ".pytest_bytecode"

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from pathlib import Path
+import sys
+
+from _pytest.assertion.rewrite import get_cache_dir
+from _pytest.isolated_bytecode_dir import isolated_bytecode_dir
+import pytest
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "prefix, source, expected",
+    [
+        ("c:/tmp/pycs", "d:/projects/src/foo.py", "c:/tmp/pycs/projects/src"),
+        (None, "d:/projects/src/foo.py", "d:/projects/src/.pytest_bytecode"),
+        ("/tmp/pycs", "/home/projects/src/foo.py", "/tmp/pycs/home/projects/src"),
+        (None, "/home/projects/src/foo.py", "/home/projects/src/.pytest_bytecode"),
+        ("", "/home/projects/src/foo.py", "/home/projects/src/.pytest_bytecode"),
+    ],
+)
+def test_isolated_bytecode_dir(monkeypatch, prefix, source, expected) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.delenv("PYTHONPYCACHEPREFIX", raising=False)
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "pycache_prefix", prefix, raising=False)
+
+    assert isolated_bytecode_dir(Path(source)) == Path(expected)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("source", ["", ".", "foo.py", "/foo.py", "/"])
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("prefix", [None, "/tmp/pycs"])
+def test_matches_get_cache_dir(monkeypatch, prefix, source) -> None:
+    monkeypatch.setattr(sys, "pycache_prefix", prefix, raising=False)
+    path = Path(source)
+    expected = get_cache_dir(path)
+    if not prefix:
+        expected = expected.with_name(".pytest_bytecode")
+    assert isolated_bytecode_dir(path) == expected
